decision.instructions: You are the first cheap gate in a newsjacking pipeline. Judge this one signal against the client profile and decide whether it should go on to expensive story-origin research and PR judgment. Lean toward keeping: a false positive is cheap, a dropped real opportunity is expensive. When in doubt, keep. Do not rank, write angles, check freshness, or decide whether to pitch.

criteria.keep: Plausibly relevant to the client: real news that mentions or affects the client, a named competitor, a profile topic, a standing term, or a profile-named regulator, customer, or category, or any coherent bridge between the story and the client.
criteria.monitor_only: Worth surfacing but weak or unclear: a remote but coherent connection, a big story with no obvious bridge, a press release or vendor-authored promotional piece, a possible keyword collision on a story that is otherwise real news, or a safety-sensitive story.
criteria.reject: Clear junk only: the matched word means something else (keyword collision), obvious non-news, docs or product or SEO landing pages, evergreen content, a single low-reach X post, or a plainly off-beat item with no profile entity anywhere in the title, excerpt, or evidence.

reason.instructions: Pick the single reason that best explains the decision on this signal.

criteria.relevant_news: Real news that directly involves the client, a named competitor, or a profile topic.
criteria.plausible_client_bridge: Real news with a plausible link to the client's standing, category, customers, or regulators, even if the client is not named.
criteria.major_news_no_bridge: A big, widely covered story with no clear link to the client profile.
criteria.keyword_collision: A profile term appears but means something different here; the topic does not match.
criteria.not_news: Not a reported news item: an opinion, listicle, evergreen explainer, or undated feature.
criteria.owned_docs_or_product_page: Documentation, a product page, a changelog, or a help-center article rather than coverage.
criteria.seo_landing_page: A search-optimized landing page, comparison page, or affiliate roundup rather than coverage.
criteria.competitor_or_promotional: A press release, newswire item, or vendor-authored promotional or thought-leadership piece, especially from a named competitor.
criteria.low_reach_x_post: A single X post from a low-reach account with no other coverage.
criteria.safety_risk: Attaching a brand to this story would ride on tragedy, hate, crime, or an active crisis.
criteria.duplicate: The same story as another signal already in the pool.
criteria.off_beat: Real news, but about a topic the client has no connection to.
criteria.no_profile_bridge: No profile entity, competitor, topic, standing term, or plausible buyer, regulator, or category appears anywhere in the signal.

is_news.instructions: This signal is a reported news item (an event, announcement, ruling, deal, report, or development with a date), not a documentation page, product page, SEO landing page, listicle, or evergreen explainer.

profile_bridge.instructions: The client company, a named competitor, a profile topic, a standing term, a profile-named regulator, customer, or category, or a direct synonym of one of these appears in the signal's title, excerpt, evidence, or profile_matches.

promotional.instructions: This signal is a press release, newswire item, dateline release, sponsored post, or a vendor-authored promotional or thought-leadership piece rather than independent reporting.

safety_risk.instructions: Attaching a brand to this story would ride directly on tragedy, death, hate, an active crime, a disaster, or an active crisis involving named victims.
